# Outdoor Station Parts List {.unnumbered}

Everything to buy for the outdoor station, shop by shop, as a shopping list. The [design chapter](00-design.qmd) explains the choice of each part, and the [power chapter](01-power.qmd) how the power parts connect.

::: {.callout-note}
The prices are those of the shops linked, in euros, at the time of writing, without the shipping costs.
:::

## Gotronic: electronics and cables, about 69 €

[Gotronic](https://www.gotronic.fr) is a French shop that sells the Seeed Studio, Adafruit and DFRobot boards.

| Qty | Part | Price |
|-----|------|-------|
| 1 | [XIAO ESP32-S3, pins soldered](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-carte-xiao-esp32s3-soude-47619.htm) | 10.50 € |
| 1 | [Grove Shield for XIAO](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-shield-grove-xiao-103020312-32393.htm) | 4.90 € |
| 1 | [Charger bq24074 (Adafruit 4755)](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-chargeur-d-accu-lipo-3-7-vcc-ada4755-33478.htm) | 17.90 € |
| 1 | [LiPo battery, 1000 mAh, JST-PH](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-accu-lipo-3-7-vcc-1000-mah-pr523450-5813.htm) | 9.90 € |
| 1 | [Thermistor NTC 10 kΩ](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-thermistance-ctn-10k-8486-3739.htm) | 0.80 € |
| 1 | [Waterproof push button, IP67, 16 mm](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-bouton-poussoir-bp16039-29350.htm) | 4.60 € |
| 2 | [Grove I2C hub, 6 ports](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-hub-6-ports-i2c-grove-103020272-31348.htm) | 3.80 € |
| 1 | [Grove cables, 30 cm, set of 5](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-lot-de-5-cables-grove-30-cm-22557.htm) | 3.30 € |
| 2 | [Grove to female connectors cables, 30 cm, set of 5](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-5-cables-30-cm-grove-4-contacts-femelles-19069.htm) | 8.40 € |
| 2 | [JST-PH 2-pin cable, with its plug](https://www.gotronic.fr/art-cordon-jst-ph-femelle-2-cts-jst2-21318.htm) | 4.40 € |

What each cable connects:

- **Grove I2C hubs**: one in the sealed box, for the clock and the INA219, and one in the shelter, for the BME280 and the later sensors. A single cable goes from the box to the shelter.
- **Grove cables**: the Grove Shield to the hub of the box, and this hub to the hub of the shelter; the others are spares for the later sensors.
- **Grove to female connectors cables**: the clock, its alarm, the BME280, the INA219 and the maintenance button use the first set; the second set is for the later sensors, and can wait for them.
- **JST-PH cables**: the charger to the Grove Shield, and the charger to the INA219 and the battery.

| 1 | [INA219 module](https://www.amazon.fr/DollaTek-capteur-Courant-Alternatif-bidirectionnel/dp/B07DK7Y35Q) | 5.99 € |
| 1 | [CR2032 coin cells, Varta, 5](https://www.amazon.fr/Varta-2032-Pile-Lithium-Pi%C3%A8ces/dp/B00TYEL11K), for the clock | about 3.40 € |

The generic INA219 module copies the design of Adafruit: the same chip and the same 0.1 Ω shunt resistor, marked R100.

## Already on the bench

These parts come from the [breadboard station](../Architecture/Phase-04/00-1-requirements.qmd):

- the **BME280** module: temperature, humidity and pressure;
- the **DS3231** module: the clock, whose LED is removed (see [The clock](00-design.qmd#the-clock));
- the **USB-C cable**, to program the XIAO;
- two **male-to-male jumper wires**, for the maintenance button.
